title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.04196v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent years have witnessed an explosive trend of scaling ego-centric human videos for robot manipulation, yet it remains unclear which data actually benefits dexterous manipulation. We present SiMDex, a similarity-based data mining framework that casts human data selection for VLA post-training in dexterous manipulation as a recommendation problem. For each robot demonstration, SiMDex runs a recall-ranking-re-ranking cascade over ~32M egocentric human samples: two stages, recall and ranking, select a task-relevant subset in a morphology-agnostic action space, and re-ranking verifies it on pixels, with no change to VLA architecture or training. Against a strong baseline trained with an equal amount of randomly sampled human data, SiMDex uses only ~1.49M mined samples (<5% of the pool) yet improves the overall success rate from 47.7% to 61.7%, showing that selective curation outperforms indiscriminate data mixing.

translated_title: SiMDex：挖掘相似的第一人称视角视频以实现跨本体灵巧操作
translated_abstract: 近年来，扩展第一人称人类视频用于机器人操作的趋势呈现爆发式增长，然而哪些数据真正有益于灵巧操作仍不明确。我们提出了SiMDex，一个基于相似度的数据挖掘框架，将灵巧操作中VLA后训练的人类数据选择问题转化为推荐问题。对于每个机器人演示，SiMDex在约3200万个第一人称人类样本上运行召回-排序-重排序级联：召回和排序两个阶段在与机器人形态无关的动作空间中选择任务相关子集，重排序阶段则在像素级别上进行验证，全程无需改变VLA架构或训练方式。与使用等量随机采样人类数据训练的强基线相比，SiMDex仅使用约149万个挖掘出的样本（不到数据池的5%），却将整体成功率从47.7%提升至61.7%，表明选择性的数据筛选优于不加区分的数据混合。
tldr: SiMDex提出基于相似度的数据挖掘框架，通过召回-排序-重排序级联从3200万条第一人称人类视频中筛选出不足5%的最相关样本，无需修改VLA架构即可将跨本体灵巧操作成功率从47.7%提升至61.7%。
en_tdlr: SiMDex is a similarity-based data mining framework that selects the most task-relevant egocentric human videos (less than 5% of a 32M-sample pool) via a recall-ranking-re-ranking cascade, boosting cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation success rate from 47.7% to 61.7% without modifying the VLA architecture.
